note: From the owner's NZCSC2019-Flags.xlsx solve sheet. Flags use the flag:hex format. Titles reconstructed from the recorded method.

challenges.title: done.php
challenges.desc: Reach the challenge's done.php page to reveal the flag (the page sets window.location = './done.php').

challenges.title: XOR Cipher
challenges.desc: A base64-encoded ciphertext must be decoded and XORed. Note: a bonus flag (ch2*) was hidden as an extra base64 blob in index.php but was never fully recovered.
challenges.method: Decode the base64 to ASCII, recover the XOR key using known ASCII, then decode the ciphertext next to the flag.

challenges.title: Cat The Flag
challenges.desc: The flag lives in a directory named flag.

challenges.title: EXIF History
challenges.desc: An image carries the flag in its metadata. A bonus flag (ch4*) was hidden further inside the image but was never fully recovered.
challenges.method: Read the image Exif data / edit history.

challenges.title: SQL Injection
challenges.desc: A login form is vulnerable to SQL injection.

challenges.title: Backwards Validate
challenges.desc: A VM contains a validation binary. A bonus flag (ch6*) required objdump-ing the validator and understanding its connect-out behaviour, but was never fully recovered.
challenges.method: The flag is spelt backwards inside the validate file on the VM.
